snippet.title: Bump - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Keep moving. Chain your hits. Punish EVERYTHING. BUMP is a fast-paced third-person shooter where standing still is a death sentence (sorry campers). Weaponize gravity and unleash physics-based brutality in a game where you either Get Good... or Get Splattered.

Music by Karl Casey @whitebataudio

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3008530/Bump/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
